notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.01
notes.notes:
The first post-release patch for the game, we focused on fixing problems that were found by the community. We also made some balancing changes based on the gameplay we have seen in the various lets-plays. The patch will be going live around 1:00 PM EST today.

General

Fixed a bug where the boss room was sending people directly back to the world select screen.
All achievements are now obtainable following this fix.
Challenge mode will now unlock upon completing this final boss.
All levels that have not yet been unlocked on the world map will show a locked icon instead of being invisible so that the player may better track their progression.
Removed the Early Access screen that we forgot to disable. (whoops)


Challenge Mode

Did an overhaul to the mode while it was inaccessible.
Now instead of providing small bite-sized challenges, it instead has alternate versions of each of the stages in the game that have had their difficulty drastically increased.
Each level is only accessible after the player has collected all twenty pixels in its normal mode counterpart.
Will add the bite-sized challenges back in as a separate mode in a later patch.


Monokrom

Reworked the Snakespeare boss fight so that there is less idle time and more of a challenge during the encounter.


Project N

Touched up artwork in various places.
Resolved an issue where one level only had 19 pixels.


Super Evo X

Resolved an issue where pixels were not showing up in one of the levels.
Touched up the ball form to feel more similar to the armadillo suit in the previous world. 
Cleaned up some artwork in the world. 
Some levels have been adjusted slightly for better game flow.


Mac OSX

Fixed a bug where a number of Mac users were unable to launch the game.


Windows XP

While we have identified an issue where users are unable to launch the game on certain Windows XP machines, we have not yet found a resolution to the problem. Please look for more news on this as we continue work on a solution.


Backend

Cleaned up various game scripts so that put less of a strain on the processor and are more easily accessed for future changes.

notes.title: BiT Evolution Release Date - June 9th
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce the release of our first title, BiT Evolution, on June 9th  on Steam. We will not only be including the final world in this patch, but a host of other new features to the game. (Including the much requested achievements and Steam Trading Cards)

Keep an eye on our social media and blog pages for more news as we get a "BiT" closer to release!

What other new features would you like to see? Post in the comments and let us know! It might just make it into the final version!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.3.0
notes.notes:
http://bitevolutiongame.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/BiT-NES-Screenshot1.png

New World
The third world of the game is now available to play! This world includes a number of new features including:

New Art Style
Power-ups
18 New Levels
15 New Enemies
7 New Music Tracks
Updated Game Camera
Variable Jumping
Background Parallax


General

Fixed a number of crashes and bugs found by the community
Improved terrain generation algorithm


Controls

Unified control schemes
Improved joystick sensitivity
Alternative control scheme added (WASD + JK)


Jungle Quest

Resolved an issue where some platforms were not allowing the player to jump onto them from below.


Monokrom

Some missing and incorrect tiles have been fixed/adjusted

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.1
notes.notes:
New Features

Cutscenes have been added to the game's second world.

General

Fullscreen in option menu will now reflect the right option if fullscreen mode was changed via option or hotkey.
Fixed a number of SFX issues.
Added enter key functionality to main menu and pause menu.
Shows BiT(s) from only the unlocked world(s) on title screen.
BiTs will now be racing each other on main menu.
Escape now cancels out of menus.

World Selection

Added animation to selection arrow.
Now displays world name and pixel information.

Temple Quest (World 1)

Fixed several bugs that could occur with the boss.
Hit boxes on some enemies have been adjusted.
Improved behavior of small glitches when directly above or below BiT.

Monokrom (World 2)

Completing all levels currently available will show a speech bubble in the overworld saying "Boss Level Coming Soon".
Fixed an issue that caused a number of people to experience lag in the world.
Fixed an issue where the platform artwork was being stretched.
